name: Towards a Unified Evaluation of Explanation Methods without Ground Truth
description: This paper proposes a set of criteria to evaluate the objectiveness of explanation methods of neural networks, which is crucial for the development of explainable AI, but it also presents significant challenges. The core challenge is that people usually cannot obtain ground-truth explanations of the neural network. To this end, we design four metrics to evaluate explanation results without ground-truth explanations. Our metrics can be broadly applied to nine benchmark methods of interpreting neural networks, which provides new insights of explanation methods.
reputation: A niche but influential interpretability benchmark paper that is often cited for proposing evaluation criteria when no ground-truth explanations exist.
notes: Non-LLM interpretability benchmark; evaluates explanation methods indirectly without ground-truth explanations, so scores are method-dependent and not directly comparable to standard accuracy-style benchmarks.
